title: Day 7: SPY 0DTE Trading Bot up 6% today, Up 29% in a week
author: Lumpy-Owl-7795
selftext:
CPI came in hot - i'm hearing. But my bot still performed relatively good today

https://preview.redd.it/f4mp4vuk8gvh1.png?width=431&format=png&auto=webp&s=9d8b21a077c475e824f620e2043ee355ae6edddd

  
Here is the timeline of what happened

  
1st Trade: For the first time in a week, my first trade was a loss

2nd Trade: this one hit 25% and 50%.

Good news is my 2nd trade has improved, so I have been green 2 days in a row for this.

My win rate for this week is 67**%: 4 wins / 2 loss across 6 trades.** 

https://preview.redd.it/9u084nyb9gvh1.png?width=1277&format=png&auto=webp&s=1b21bd0019cae1572ef24c4c3321c8dbb547f1a3



so 2 CPIs green days in 2 months. I think I can start sharing the setup now. let me know and I can send this to you. If you have feedback, please add to this -> I'm still looking to improve

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Posting the real account next to the paper one is still the most useful part. With 6 trades this week and 37 closed on paper, the results are too small to judge, so the average win, the average loss and the worst day matter more than the win rate. Two CPI mornings are two observations, so I'd keep them in the record as that and not as proof. I see a "FOMC or CPI filter" in the recent items: if it was added after seeing how those days went, treat it as a rule fitted to the last few days, write down the exact window, run it frozen, and log the trades it skips with what they would have done. If you share the setup, include the exact rules, the settings and the full trade list with losses and fees, so others can check it on their own fills. Event Cards at Cymetica are one place to look at event-based markets around CPI and FOMC, which is where 0DTE results usually split.

replies.body: No, and Cymetica is the company I work at. It builds EventTrader, a platform for event-based markets and structured event data (earnings, macro releases, and other scheduled events with timestamps), plus a set of free tools and an agents area.
